#Text=It’s a highly zoomed-in view, showing the narrow, winding streets and dense urban layout characteristic of this historic district.
#Text=Key Features & Landmarks:  Street Network: The map is dominated by a complex network of streets, many of which are quite narrow.
#Text=The street names are in Catalan and Spanish.
